description:
> Note: All are welcome.  If you apply, please let us know on the discord link below.  The in-game notification system is not reliable.  It also does not have any automatic alert for us to accept you.
 
> .......... * * * Rumours Guild Requirements: * * *..........                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
> RELAX – play the game the way that you want.  No drama.                                                                     
> IDLE – allow multiple hours for us to see applications & chat.                                                                 
> ADULTS - we are not babysitters. Be courteous to others.                                                                          
> DISCORD – required use for communication, otherwise kicked.                                                                      
>  ... Here is the link for members:  https://discord.gg/skPS7QBEs                                          
> DAILY - must donate a little the Guild Stockpile to be active.                                                                     
> USA East Coast Time - Guild Raids, Energy Pools, etc.. when                                                                   
 > ... available, and ALWAYS occur a on a weekday at 7:00PM. firm.                                                                                                                                                           
> Notifications - Search for “Notifications” in settings to adjust the # 
> ... of them the game sends you if to many.
